MANDATORY SUBMISSION Compliance Points The Executive Committee of NAAC mandated regular AQAR submission for the second and subsequent cycles of accreditation from 16 September 2016. A functional Internal Quality Assurance Cell is required for continued quality assurance activity. Minutes of IQAC meetings and compliance reports should be uploaded on the university website.
